episode_title: News Outlets Protest Trump's Media Bans, Trump At UNGA, Paramount Merger Settlement
script_en: News Outlets Protest Trump's Media Bans, Trump At UNGA, Paramount Merger Settlement.
Major news organizations are suspending use of White House pool coverage after President Trump banned reporters from CNN and two other outlets, with a court hearing set for Wednesday.
President Trump addresses the United Nations this morning aiming to cast himself as a peacemaker, a day before Iran’s president speaks, with the war between them still unresolved.
Paramount’s owners agreed to concessions to settle an antitrust lawsuit from a dozen states over their $111 billion bid for Warner Bros.
Discovery, a deal critics say will not protect jobs or the independence of CBS and CNN.
